lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: They noticed. Course they noticed. They're coming for the forge, and they've sent a frame to do it, which means they've costed it out and decided we're worth a frame.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Twenty years that fire's been lit. Longer if you count my mother's. It has not gone out through two sieges and a winter that took nine of us, and it is not going out tonight over four crates of forms.

choices.text: Move the forge. Fires can be rebuilt.
